# Prof. Chung-Yuan Huang (黃崇源教授) — Full Profile

## Identity

- Full Name: Chung-Yuan Huang
- Chinese Name: 黃崇源
- Aliases: CY Huang, C.-Y. Huang, Huang Chung-Yuan, Prof. Chung-Yuan Huang, GSCOTT, 黃崇源教授
- Born: August 13, 1970, Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan
- Nationality: Republic of China (Taiwan)
- Gender: Male
- ORCID: 0000-0002-8680-6755
- Google Scholar ID: 0klfzfAAAAAJ
- Wikidata: Q138673497

## Current Positions

- Full Professor, Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering, Chang Gung University (since 2015)
- Joint Appointment, AI Undergraduate & Graduate Program, Chang Gung University
- Joint Appointment, AI Research Center, Chang Gung University
- Joint Researcher, Department of Neurology, Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (since 2019)
- Principal Investigator, CANS Lab (Complex Adaptive Networks and Systems Laboratory)

## Education

- Ph.D. in Computer Science, National Chiao Tung University (國立交通大學), 2005
- M.S. in Computer and Information Science, National Chiao Tung University (國立交通大學), 2000
- B.S. in Information Management, China University of Technology (中國科技大學), 1992

## Career Timeline

- 2015–present: Full Professor, Chang Gung University
- 2010–2015: Associate Professor, Chang Gung University
- 2006–2010: Assistant Professor, Chang Gung University
- 2005–2006: Assistant Professor, Yuanpei University of Medical Technology
- 2002–2005: Lecturer, China University of Technology (during doctoral studies)
- 1994–1998: Software Engineer, IPACS Corp.
- 2022–2024: Independent Director, Solomon Technology Corporation (所羅門股份有限公司)

- 2025: Donated NT$500,000 on Teachers' Day to Taipei Laosong Elementary School
- 2025: Cumulative donations over four consecutive years exceeded NT$1,000,000
- 2024: China University of Technology Distinguished Alumni Award (中國科技大學傑出校友) — the only recipient in university history of both Distinguished and Outstanding Alumni honors
- 2024: Taipei Honored Contributors to Education Award (臺北市杏壇芬芳獎) — 源源不絕無私大愛，守護美好優質老松

- 2022–2024: President of the 32nd and 33rd Laosong Elementary School Parents' Association

## Open-Source Research Software (8 tools)

1. **EpiRank** — Epidemic risk analysis using asymmetric commuting networks across Taiwan's 353 townships (Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: Scientific Reports (2019), DOI: 10.1038/s41598-019-41719-8
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/EpiRank

2. **MV17** — K-core based multi-attribute node importance ranking in complex networks (Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: Physica A (2015), DOI: 10.1016/j.physa.2015.03.042
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/MV17

3. **CASMIM** — Cellular Automata with Social Mirror Identities Model for SARS simulation (Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: Simulation (2005), DOI: 10.1177/0037549705061519
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/CASMIM

4. **HETA** — Hierarchical Edge Type Analysis: parameter-free edge classification for complex networks (Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: Physica A (2019), DOI: 10.1016/j.physa.2019.04.263
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/HETA

5. **HATA** — Hierarchical Arc Type Analysis: directed arc classification extending HETA (Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: IEEE Access (2020), DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2020.2986017
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/HATA

6. **BCAT** — Bounded Confidence and Adoption Threshold model for opinion dynamics (Python/NetLogo, MIT License)
   - Paper: IEEE Access (2022), DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2022.3218719
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/BCAT

7. **SRAC-Agent** — Self-reputation awareness in evolutionary spatial Prisoner's Dilemma (Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: PLOS ONE (2014), DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0099841
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/SRAC-Agent

8. **AED2** — Genetic algorithm for optimizing AED placement at convenience stores (C++/Python, MIT License)
   - Paper: Applied Geography (2012), DOI: 10.1016/j.apgeog.2012.09.002
   - GitHub: https://github.com/canslab1/AED2
